name: All four assessment detail pages render a Result outcomes section
description: Navigating through each of the four assessment detail pages via the 'Explore other assessments' links shows each page's title and a Result outcomes section. (Result-type enumeration removed: listing all four type names made the checker scroll-to-find each one and block.)

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Solstice assessment detail page
Verify the page heading reads 'The Solstice Cycle Assessment' and a 'Result outcomes' section is present on the page.
Under 'Explore other assessments', click the Turing link
Verify the page heading reads 'The Modes of Mind Assessment' and a 'Result outcomes' section is present.
Under 'Explore other assessments', click the Pride link
Verify the page heading reads 'The Spectrum of Self Assessment' and a 'Result outcomes' section is present.
Under 'Explore other assessments', click the Passage link
Verify the page heading reads 'The Passage of Time Assessment' and a 'Result outcomes' section is present.
